pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Whispered Narration Intro]
(soft sogeum airy breath, distant gayageum harmonics and deep melancholic ajaeng drone, signature hook melody introduced in first 10 seconds)

너 떠난 그날, 아무 말도 없었지
그게 잠시일 줄 알았어
하지만 시간이 지나도 still waiting

[Verse 1]
(low ajaeng sustained notes with delicate gayageum plucks, subtle janggu rhythm building loneliness)

창가에 앉아 우리 사진을 봐
웃던 네 얼굴이 자꾸 흐려져
혹시 나처럼 너도 울고 있을까

[Pre-Chorus]
(gayageum arpeggio rising slowly, ajaeng glissando, percussion layering gradually, taepyeongso soft longing tease)

말 한마디면 됐을 텐데
왜 그땐 그렇게 멀어졌을까

[BUILD]
(janggu & buk rolls increasing density, ajaeng pitch rising, deep sub bass rumble growing, sogeum ornamentation adding tension)

[DROP]
(silence 0.6sec → immediate heavy punch: deep sub bass + janggu/buk powerful hit, taepyeongso lead dominates with emotional soaring melody full of longing, gayageum rhythm flowing through)

밤이 되면 네가 생각나
불빛 아래 그리움이 쌓여
아직 그 자리에 I’m still here
waiting for you tonight

[Chorus]
(full traditional fusion groove, bright female vocal carrying deep emotion, male deep low harmony anchoring sorrow)

밤이 되면 네가 생각나
불빛 아래 그리움이 쌓여
돌아올 것 같아 문을 바라보다
오늘도 널 기다리는 나야

[Verse 2]
(softer ajaeng long tones, gayageum delicate strums, male low vocal adding heavy emptiness)

오늘도 술 한잔에 너를 담고
텅 빈 방엔 너의 향기만 남아
아무리 지워도 잊히질 않아

[Rap Break]
(male deep aggressive rhythmic rap, driving janggu & buk with afrobeat groove, ajaeng low emotional stabs, taepyeongso short melancholic motifs)

Yo, empty room echoes with your scent in the night
Still sitting by the window, chasing faded light
Ajaeng cries heavy, gayageum strings bleed pain
Taepyeongso wails the words I can’t explain
Bass hits deep like the void you left behind
I’m still at the same place, losing track of time

[BUILD 2]
(denser percussion layers, rising taepyeongso wail with trills, full sub bass swell, maximum emotional tension)

[DROP 2]
(immediate heavy impact, taepyeongso lead stronger with soaring emotional melody, full percussion explosion, female emotional adlib)

밤이 되면 네가 생각나
불빛 아래 그리움이 쌓여
아직 그 자리에 I’m still here
waiting for you tonight

[Final Chorus]
(maximum energy, layered male & female vocals, full instrumentation with powerful hook repetition)

밤이 되면 네가 생각나
불빛 아래 그리움이 쌓여
돌아올 것 같아 문을 바라보다
오늘도 널 기다리는 나야
밤이 되면 더 외로워져
하루가 너로 가득 차 있어
언젠가 다시 문을 열고 와줘
한 번만이라도 나를 안아줘

[Outro]
(fade with sogeum soft air, lingering gayageum harmonics and deep ajaeng drone, whispered male "still at the same place... waiting for you")
pkg.sunoStyle:
Korean traditional fusion EDM with afrobeat groove.
Instruments: gayageum, ajaeng, taepyeongso, sogeum, janggu, buk, kkwaenggwari, jing.
Bass: deep sub bass, strong, punchy, clean from kick.
Drums: afrobeat groove + Korean traditional rhythm.
Drop: instant hit after build, bass + Korean percussion dominate. Taepyeongso or ajaeng lead within 0.3 sec. Kkwaenggwari for tension only, jing for resonance.
Vocal: female bright and emotional. male deep, thick, heavy and resonant.
Male rap: aggressive, rhythmic, low-register English rap.
Structure: build → drop → chorus. 100-110 BPM.
Atmosphere: traditional + modern + cinematic Joseon night vibe.
Restrictions: no modern synth lead, no weak bass, no thin vocal, traditional instruments must remain clearly recognizable.
